Saburô Uchiyama

University of Tsukuba

A close relation of the Top 100: not in the algorithmic ranking by publication count, but placed in the immediate orbit of canonical Goldbach researchers by the Mathematics Genealogy Project's advisor-student network.

Google ScholarSearch results
Close-relation rank1 of 6
UniversityUniversity of Tsukuba
Network proximity (PPR score)0.00803

A Japanese analytic number theorist whose work covered the distribution of primes in arithmetic progressions and integers representable as sums of two squares, including a short-interval conjecture that bears his name. He is the doctoral advisor of Koichi Kawada, which places him directly beside the Top 100 in the genealogy graph.
